verdict.rationale: ROS 2's source and documentation live in public GitHub repositories (github.com/ros2/ros2, ros2/ros2_documentation), and community members independently describe it as open source that anyone can improve. However, no evidence item names the license or documents its terms. Missing for 10: a named open-source license (e.g. a LICENSE file or license statement), first-party documentation of the licensing terms, and evidence of source availability across the core packages beyond the umbrella repo.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The Robot Operating System (ROS) is a set of software libraries and tools that help you build robot applications.
ROS might not be perfect, but it's so much better than anything else that exists, and it's open source.
being open source means everyone can improve it
